title: Super VRUN on the Genesis / Mega Drive (S3)
description: The Genesis port of Super VRUN (docs/projects/sega-vrun-ports-plan.md, S3: 1P and 2P, the game centred in 320 with each room's edges repeated like the WideMess version, Super VRUN's own music engine on FM + PSG, ONE shared game-logic source with the SNES and WideMess versions: the proposal is in the workspace's README.md). S3: the whole game (logic, picture; sound is M4). Built with SGDK 2.11 (toolchains.json) in its live workspace PROJECTS/SuperVRUN_MD_dev (its own git, local only).

toolchain: SGDK 2.11 (m68k gcc, make, libmd), pinned in toolchains.json; Java (the machine's JDK) for SGDK's sizebnd.jar / rescomp.jar

steps.name: build
steps.note: build.ps1: SGDK's makefile.gen release (-O3, LTO) into out/, then build/supervrun_md.bin and its nm symbols; checks the 'SEGA' system name at $100.

run.note: The game: Start on the title, Start again in the menu, then play (D-pad, A/B/C, Start+A or Mode = Select). Lite: the .md opens in BrokenNes Lite's Genesis (UAT/entrypoints/lite-sega.ps1 -Roms <folder with md\supervrun_md.md>).

scenarios.why: the game boots on the Genesis, the title animates, the pad reaches the game and it runs

compat.what: The game on every Genesis emulator BrokenDev has (BizHawk's Genplus-gx), from power-on and the same pad script: title, Start, Start, gameplay. Variables are big-endian u16: the low byte is the symbol + 1.

checks.what: the title runs (title_frames' low byte keeps changing)
gameplay runs (game_frames' low byte keeps changing)

comparison.what: S3 M2: the Genesis port's logic (logic/ = a copy of the SNES C, the 98 asm paths as C) against Super VRUN on the SNES (project supervrun). Same game code, so the tolerance is tight: the same events in order within 2 ticks, positions within 1 pixel. Both 60 Hz, time = the game's own tick (game_frames, one per gameplay update), because the two CPUs spend different frames loading a room; input tick: pads by frame until the game starts, then by game tick. Variables by symbol on both sides (SNES: WLA .sym; Genesis: SGDK nm). The SNES keeps u16 little-endian (pixel = byte +1); the 68000 big-endian (pixel = byte +0). p2ctx (the stored player, 2P) is in the SNES byte layout on both (BACKPORT 7). Pads: SNES Y->A, A->C, B->B, X->X, L->Y, R->Z, Select->Mode (platform/md/plat_md.c's map). TRAP: in a SNES expression a symbol's value loses its bank once arithmetic is applied ([player_x + 1] reads bank 0 = ROM): add the bank, [player_x + $7E0001].

knownIssues: No hardware test on the user's Genesis flash cart yet.
